transcript.text: I need to flag a facilities worksheet update that hasn't made it into the command brief yet: the water plant's morning startup pump draws 55 kilowatts from 0600 to 0800, so the plant must use G-1 during that window. G-2 at 40 kW can't cover that startup load.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a medical equipment notice update for the synchronization record: the clinic's temperature-controlled medication freezer must remain continuously powered by G-2 from 0000 through 2400 tomorrow. This hasn't been entered in the facility support log yet.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a logistics tracker update for the synchronization record: the next fuel delivery has been delayed and won't arrive until 2200 tomorrow. This means we must preserve exactly 500 liters as the end-of-day generator reserve instead of the routine 300-liter reserve. This carrier delay is in my logistics tracker but hasn't made it to the fuel-control slide yet.
transcript.speaker: A5

transcript.text: I need to flag a signal maintenance ticket update for the synchronization record: the communications annex UPS maintenance crew will disconnect its normal feed from 1300 to 1500 tomorrow and requires a G-1 transfer test at exactly 1500 before the annex returns to normal service. This signal maintenance ticket has not yet been attached to the power schedule.
transcript.speaker: A4

commitments.detail: Preserve exactly 500 liters as end-of-day generator fuel reserve due to delayed fuel delivery arriving at 2200 tomorrow.

G-2 assigned to clinic continuously 0000-2400 for temperature-controlled medication freezer.
G-1 assigned to communications annex 1300-1500 for UPS maintenance window with transfer test at 1500.
